about_the_game:
In this dark fantasy world, ascend a twisted, ever-changing Tower to rescue captured villagers and confront a mysterious evil lurking at its peak. Rise of the Dark Tower is a rogue-lite built for replay-ability, blending tight, skill-based combat with challenging floors, randomized loot, and dynamic enemy encounters. Each run offers new relics, abilities, and paths, encouraging creative builds and adaptive strategies. Unlock upgrades, uncover hidden secrets, and survive intense boss battles that test your mastery of the game’s systems.

Features:

  • True rogue-lite progression: Each run is a fresh start where your choices and skill matter. Unlock powerful relics, weapons, and abilities as you climb. Randomized traps, puzzles, and enemies ensure every attempt is unpredictable—rewarding the cunning and punishing the careless.

  • Randomized hazards and build-defining abilities: No two runs play alike thanks to a vast pool of loot, weapons, and blessings that combine in surprising ways. Your success depends on adapting your build to the challenges and perks you find.

  • Fast-paced action combat that rewards skill: Combat is tight and responsive, demanding quick reflexes and smart decision-making. Dodging, running, and striking are only part of the fight—knowing when to press the advantage or retreat can be the difference between survival and starting over.

  • A quirky and memorable cast of characters: Meet a variety of unique personalities with distinct voices and stories. These encounters add humor, mystery, and depth, making the journey through the Tower feel alive and engaging.

Road Map Features:

  • We plan to add unlockable content in future updates, such as new character, additional secrets, and new abilities!

  • We do not plan to add any micro-transactions. We do plan to add unlockable cosmetics and artworks!

  • We will be holding polls and contests, giving players the chance to help improve the game and earn prizes.

  • We plan to expand our soundtrack and special effects.

New Updates for Release vs Demo Version:

  • Objectives and Guide improved.

  • New Main Character sprites

  • New enemies

  • New Special Effects

  • Lore drops hidden in each floor. 

  • 4 New Abilities

  • Skippable Dialogs

  • Improved loading of assets to help performance

  • Implemented Achievements

Known Issues Getting Fixed or have been Solved:

  • None at this time. If you do find something, let us know on our discord and we will improve it!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Controller support recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Works well with controller or keyboard

short_description: Climb the twisted Tower in this dark fantasy roguelite action game. Rescue villagers, face mysterious evils, and master skill-based combat. With challenging floors, randomized loot, and fierce bosses, every run offers new challenges and unique builds to conquer.
